luke.description: The Luke instance attached to this component.

parentSelector.description:
A parent selector that can be used to distinguish between multiple instances of a component within a page.
This can be leveraged to create 1-to-1 mappings between {@link UITestComponent}s so that functions
called on a component are limited only to the scope of that component in the UI.

spinner.description: The spinner that masks the component when data is loading

renderingSelectors.description:
An array of selectors used to determine whether the page/component exist or is rendered.  These selectors will be searched
for within the {@link #parentSelector}.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time that Luke will retry an action

cardListSelector.description: The selector for the card list.

cardListTitleSelector.description: The selector for card list title.

cardListHeaderSelector.description: The selector for the card list header.

cardSelector.description: The selector for a card within the card list component.

cardHeadlineSelector.description: The selector for the card headline.

indicatorBarSelector.description: The selector for an indicator bar within a card component.
